scope: Locally fixed before new outputs; previously analysed documents and informed prompt choices. Not an external preregistration, document holdout, correctness study, or proof of novelty.
model_availability: Not checked; failure must be reported, not silently substituted.

primary_outcomes: admission and common-label changes per replicate
analysis.validity: Use the original strict Answer: True/False parser. Determine assessability separately for each revision, using its required cells; unrelated cells cannot exclude rows. Report format-invalid responses, unassessed rows and observed-cohort versus full-input verdicts separately. Never recode an invalid answer as False.
analysis.inference: Descriptive per-replicate results for all four revisions. No pooled independence assumption, significance tests, equivalence claim, or detection-accuracy score. Identical-prompt repeats contextualize variation; they do not establish a causal noise correction.
analysis.interpretation: Contracts state intended relationships, not proven semantic equivalence. Direct assertions have the same information and requirements, so better detection is not assumed. Filter-only revisions share reference map answers; map-only revisions share reference filter answers. Preservation of those shared components is by construction. All-row masks are derived views, not composed-pipeline executions.
analysis.change_policy: No tuning after new outputs are inspected. Changed prompts, requirements, rows, parser, settings or analysis create a separately identified amended protocol. Any pilot must use a separate plan and remain excluded from this evaluation.

execution.note: This tool prepares and verifies the protocol only. A runner must bind native prompts, installed framework sources, checkpoints, request logs and this plan before any execution. No paid execution command is supplied.

estimate.note: Characters/4 plus 128 prompt tokens per row; heuristic, not a spending cap or runtime prediction. Retries and latency are additional. No dollar prices assumed.
